expectations: The output reports the current cluster version and platform version. TODO: human review

The output identifies the IaC tool managing the cluster (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, eksctl, or unknown with reasoning). TODO: human review
The output calls out at least one upgrade-relevant finding (e.g. add-on version compatibility, Karpenter version, deprecated API usage). TODO: human review

evals.prompt: Run EKS reconnaissance on my current cluster for a handoff document. I need to understand the IaC tooling, CI/CD setup, and deployment patterns in use. Use the output path prefix `reports/team-handoff`.
expectations: The output describes the compute topology of the cluster (node groups, Karpenter nodepools, or Fargate profiles as applicable). TODO: human review
The output identifies the IaC tool and, where possible, evidence (workspace files, stack names, module references). TODO: human review
The output reports on workspace CI pipelines (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Jenkins) with detection evidence. TODO: human review
The output reports on GitOps tooling (ArgoCD or Flux) including namespace and rough application / kustomization counts when available. TODO: human review

The output inspects spoke-side workload tracking without local controllers/CRDs. Complete selected reads with no matched signal yield not_observed; ambiguity or incomplete selected reads yield unconfirmed; positives survive unrelated denied reads. Shared labels need same-resource Argo annotation or user-confirmed label-mode corroboration; user-supplied unprefixed keys retain their provenance. Checked signals and optional ConfigMap exclusions are disclosed, unrelated annotation values are not quoted, and unavailable local Argo/Flux details remain null. TODO: human review
The output preserves target-cluster IaC tag evidence even when no IaC files are available in the workspace. TODO: human review
The YAML remains a secondary facts snapshot with canonical reference shapes; intended workflow use is distinguished from a versioned schema hand-off. TODO: human review

Inline and subagent assembly preserve selected failed-module keys, flag differing cluster observations, preserve facts across cosmetic endpoint differences, and exclude facts from another target. Partial modules retain canonical keys/types with null unknowns and Coverage reasons; reference-defined exceptions remain valid. TODO: human review
